summary: Add an optional writer-owned SQLite mutation observer for commit-consistent retention deadlines.

replay.detail: The existing Store constructors do not activate the observer; this change adds no startup replay or projection invalidation.

schema.detail: No stored tables, indexes, triggers or migrations change; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint selection, retention rules and RULES_VERSION are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds the optional smallclaims WriterObserver trait and WriterConnection::new_with_observer constructor. Existing constructors and CommitObserver behaviour remain compatible; no client, replication or harness wire fields change. Runtime activation is a separate change.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade pause or coordinated fleet restart is introduced. Standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies; no outage timing is claimed.

manual.detail: Existing installations need no data repair, configuration conversion or observer activation.

recovery.detail: No stored format changes or additional recovery procedure. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and use normal roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify whole-release binary-only downgrade.
